title: Prioritized next engineering work
summary: Next steps are evidence-quality and observability improvements ahead of any purchase authority: authenticated status subscriber, exact usage/metering, invoice reconciliation, cross-provider pricing and backtested forecast calibration, then governed commissioning.
invariants: Never create a live cloud-buy operation before explicit financial ceilings, provider IAM boundaries, approval gate, reversal/timeout and independent human oversight are verified.
Use native native-job lifecycle and storage/transport contracts; do not create shadow ownership or migration state machines.
Publish a documented end-to-end verification trace including every veto and a defensible counterfactual.
Keep monitoring failure distinct from zero cost.

provenance.claim: Cloud Economics v0.1-dev8 source evidence; status=ROADMAP.

procedure: 1. Add read-only authenticated subscription to Migratable Job status via the authorized Queue Fabric/Connect Selector boundary.
2. Add correlation of authoritative execution consumption and exact measured bytes with job/lease/checkpoint identity.
3. Add immutable provider invoice adapters plus units/currency/tax/FX reconciliation and correction lineage.
4. Build backtested price forecasting with error bars and provider-specific change regimes.
5. Prove total cost and deadline tradeoffs in closed-loop paper running across a multi-node estate.
6. Only then design separately reviewed purchase/cancel permissions, quotas, budgets and approval workflow.
